data.name: Husani
data.long_meaning: The name Husani is derived from the Arabic word husn, meaning 'goodness' or 'beauty'. This name is a compound of husn and ani, which together mean 'friend of God'. In Islamic tradition, the name is often given to children as a reminder of their connection to Allah and as a symbol of righteousness and piety.

The name Husani also highlights the importance of being a friend of God and striving to please Him in all aspects of life, as reflected in the second part of the name, ani.
